title: Grindr CEO says AI is doing work that would have required hiring 200 additional engineers
excerpt: Grindr CEO George Arison said that AI had increased its engineering output 2.5-fold. Without AI, he said the company would need 200 more engineers.
content_html:
Just how much human engineering work is AI capable of delivering? Grindr put a number to it.

In a letter to shareholders, Grindr CEO George Arison touted the company's advances with AI. He gave a "conservative estimate" that engineering output increased by 2.5x between July 2025 and April 2026, with "minimal growth" in its engineering staff.

Arison later said that the actual multiple was 3.5x on Grindr's second-quarter earnings call. The company changed it to 2.5x because they thought the larger increase sounded "unreasonable," he said.

"Before GenAI, producing that much technical output would have required roughly 200 additional engineers and approximately $60 million in annual cost," Arison wrote.

Grindr measured output in the amount of code shipped. That's a controversial metric; some say it prioritizes quantity over quality.

Marco Argenti, Goldman Sachs' chief information officer, told Business Insider in May that measuring lines of code was "not really a great way to do it."

Others attempt to measure productivity by the volume of AI tokens spent, which can lead to tokenmaxxing.

Arison told CNBC on Thursday that the company was on track to spend $6 million on tokens this year. An analyst asked Arison about tokens on the company's earnings call.

"We are of the view that people should use all the tools that are out there and not really worry about the cost to them as long as the ROI that we want to see is there," he responded.

Even if Grindr did want to bring on the 200 engineers needed to match that AI productivity jump, the CEO said in his letter that the industry's constraint has always been a "scarcity of exceptional engineering talent."

AI allows Grindr to keep its most exceptional engineers focused on the areas where it "most benefits from human creativity and judgment," he wrote.

Engineers are worried about their jobs. AI code editors are becoming increasingly competent, while layoffs rip through Big Tech. Companies like Block and Atlassian have specifically cited AI in their layoff announcements.

Despite the hubbub, job openings for software engineering roles actually rose this year.

Arison is one of the few CEOs who has put into numbers how many jobs would be needed to achieve a similar output without AI. The Grindr CEO's remarks were notably not about cutting jobs, but rather not creating new ones. (But engineers could understandably read CEO quotes like this and worry about the possibility that a company could eventually decide to downsize in the name of "do more with less.")

On the earnings call, Grindr' CEO shared an anecdote about the changing workforce size.

When he took the Grindr job, Arison said he described his vision to a mentor, noting it would require 250-300 engineers. His mentor said that needing all those engineers was "the old world," and that AI coding could do much of the work.

"It's a really incredible outcome for us," Arison said.

content_html_zh:
人工智能到底能够完成多少人类工程工作？ Grindr 给它添加了一个数字。

Grindr 首席执行官 George Arison 在致股东的一封信中赞扬了该公司在人工智能方面取得的进步。 他给出的“保守估计”是，2025 年 7 月至 2026 年 4 月期间，工程产出增长了 2.5 倍，而工程人员的增长“微乎其微”。

Arison 后来在 Grindr 第二季度财报电话会议上表示，实际市盈率是 3.5 倍。 他说，该公司将其改为 2.5 倍，因为他们认为更大的增幅听起来“不合理”。

“在 GenAI 出现之前，产生如此多的技术输出需要大约 200 名额外的工程师以及大约 6000 万美元的年度成本，”阿里森写道。

Grindr 以交付的代码量来衡量输出。 这是一个有争议的指标。有人说它优先考虑数量而不是质量。

高盛 (Goldman Sachs) 首席信息官马可·阿根蒂 (Marco Argenti) 五月份向《商业内幕》表示，测量代码行数“并不是一个真正好的方法”。

其他人试图通过花费的人工智能代币数量来衡量生产力，这可能会导致代币最大化。

Arison 周四告诉 CNBC，该公司今年有望在代币上花费 600 万美元。 一位分析师在公司财报电话会议上向阿里森询问了有关代币的问题。

“我们认为，只要我们希望看到的投资回报率存在，人们就应该使用现有的所有工具，而不是真正担心他们的成本，”他回答道。

即使 Grindr 确实想引进 200 名工程师来满足人工智能生产率的飞跃，首席执行官在信中表示，该行业的限制始终是“缺乏杰出的工程人才”。

他写道，人工智能让 Grindr 能够让最优秀的工程师专注于“最能从人类创造力和判断力中受益”的领域。

工程师们担心他们的工作。 人工智能代码编辑器的能力越来越强，而大型科技公司却在裁员。 Block 和 Atlassian 等公司在裁员公告中特别提到了人工智能。

尽管存在喧嚣，但今年软件工程职位的职位空缺实际上有所增加。

阿里森是少数几位计算出在没有人工智能的情况下需要多少工作岗位才能​​实现类似产出的首席执行官之一。 Grindr 首席执行官的言论显然不是要裁员，而是要创造新职位。 （但是，工程师们可以理解地看到首席执行官这样的引言，并担心公司最终可能会以“少花钱多办事”的名义决定缩小规模。）

在财报电话会议上，Grindr 首席执行官分享了一个有关劳动力规模变化的轶事。

当阿里森接受 Grindr 工作时，他向导师描述了自己的愿景，并指出这需要 250-300 名工程师。 他的导师说，需要所有这些工程师是“旧世界”，人工智能编码可以完成大部分工作。

“这对我们来说真是令人难以置信的结果，”阿里森说。
